resources.string: TV is overriding your launcher choice

Android has already selected DigitalSignageTV as the Home app, but this TV still opens its built-in launcher. Selecting it again in Settings will not resolve this restriction.\n\nChoose Open on boot to start this app after a restart while keeping the TV’s Home screen. Replacing the built-in launcher on this TV requires administrator setup.
Choose how the TV app starts
Set as launcher to use DigitalSignageTV as your Home screen, or choose Open on boot to start it after a restart while keeping your current Home screen.
Open on boot enabled. Your Home launcher is unchanged.

Android requires “Display over other apps” to open DigitalSignageTV from the background after boot. On the next screen, allow this permission for DigitalSignageTV, then press Back to return. This app does not draw floating windows. Your Home launcher will stay unchanged.

Allow “Display over other apps” for DigitalSignageTV, then return to this app to finish setup. If your TV hides or restricts this permission, ask your administrator for setup assistance. Some TVs may delay or restrict startup. Cancel continues without enabling boot startup.
DigitalSignageTV is now this TV’s Home app.

DigitalSignageTV is not currently this TV’s default Home app. In Settings, select DigitalSignageTV as the Home app or default launcher, and choose Always if asked.

Some TV manufacturers restrict this setting or give their built-in launcher priority. If the option is missing or does not take effect, contact your TV administrator for one-time device setup. The app cannot override these restrictions.

Choose Later to continue using the app.
